title.narrative: Proyecto de Generacin y Transmisin CEEE

description.narrative: El objetivo general del Programa es ampliar, rehabilitar y modernizar la infraestructura de generacin y transmisin de la CEEE-GT para mejorar la confiabilidad del servicio, atender la demanda creciente de energa elctrica y actualizar tecnolgicamente la infraestructura. El Programa de inversiones ayudar a garantizar la construccin de la infraestructura elctrica necesaria para soportar el incremento de demanda que se espera tenga un pico durante el Mundial de Ftbol 2014.

The operation's objective is to expand, rehabilitate and modernize the generation and transmission infrastructure of the CEEE-GT, in order to improve the reliability of the service which includes the metropolitan region of Porto Alegre in the Rio Grande do Su, to serve the incresing electricity demand and to update tecnologically the infraestructure. The Invesment Program will help to guarantee the construction of the required electricity infrastructure to support the increase in demand with an expected peak during the World Cup 2014.
